test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Mother’s back was too ______ to work any longer, so she lay down to rest.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sore"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The most appropriate word here to fill in the blank is **"sore".**
 
• Here the sentence says "Mother's back was too ___ to work any longer, so she lay down to rest."
 
• **Sore** is the condition when our back hurts after sitting or standing in the same position for a long time.
 
 
• Example: *My back is sore, and I need to go to the doctor.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the answer is** sore.**

**​**

**​ The correct sentence is: **Mother's back was too sore to work any longer, so she lay down to rest.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information __**

 The meaning of the other words is as follows:

 
• **Sick** means to be ill.

 
 
• Example: He has been **sick** since Monday.
 
 
 
• **Sour** means having a sharp taste like lemon.
 
 
• Example: The curd is **sour**.
 
 
 
• **Soft** means something which can be easily hurt or broken.
 
 
• Example: She is a **soft**-hearted person.
 
 

1f
